'''B9-D7''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where it acted as a messenger, projecting [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Siturn]] so he could communicate with Imperials.<ref name="TORTFC" />
